BR-01: Auto-generate N blank profiles based on service maxProfiles when an account is created.
BR-02: Reservations must capture the current price of items.
BR-03: Combo discount applies when a reservation has more than one item type.
BR-04: Anti-overbooking: a profile can only have one active subscription.
BR-05: Anti-fraud: same receipt URL cannot be used twice for a reservation.
BR-06: AccountAvailability is calculated at query time (AVAILABLE, PARTIAL, FULL).
BR-10: EXPIRING_SOON calculated dynamically / used by background automations to detect overdue payments.
BR-11: CANCELLED status is a permanent termination of a subscription.
